withdrawn_claim.origin: Uncorrected draft manuscript artifact from early exploratory single-cluster run without cluster signflip permutation.

committed_source_estimands.design: 2x2 Factorial (Quality Q_HIGH/Q_LOW x Standing S_HIGH/S_LOW) across 96 paired worlds in 24 clusters
committed_source_estimands.permutation_test: Phipson-Smyth Monte Carlo 8,192 cluster sign-flip permutations

Q_HIGH_calibrated.interpretation: High status modestly amplifies high-quality authority, but fails to reach alpha=0.05 two-sided significance under cluster permutation.

Q_LOW_misleading.interpretation: High status equally amplifies misleading authority, inducing equivalent downside utility loss.

pooled_counterbalanced_effect.interpretation: Exact zero net effect. In a counterbalanced environment where truth and error are equally likely to carry high status, institutional standing provides zero average advantage.

policy_invariance_audit.mechanism: Code explicitly ignores status attributes; deterministic zero shift confirms absence of status leakage.

p02_context_membrane_ablation.interpretation: Instantaneous context provides an auxiliary sensor advantage of +0.0161 utility over time-gated context. It must be explicitly classified as an independent real-time sensor rather than part of the delayed ambient observation stream.

p03_policy_component_ablation.conclusion: Component decomposition reveals that composite policy performance is driven jointly by adaptive memory decay, active diagnostic probing, and context conditioning, rather than static prior authority weights alone.

fiber_confounding_witness.finding: In Family D, optimal action alignment occurs at tick 2, while belief revision does not occur until tick 12+. Measuring behavioral alignment alone severely misclassifies the timing of epistemic truth recovery.

p04_correction_timeline.conclusion: Epistemic truth recovery must be separated into four distinct metrics: evidence arrival, posterior belief revision, behavioral action alignment, and formal claim warrant.

reclassifications.definition: An unrealizable synthetic upper-bound computed with full access to hidden simulation ground truth. It acts as an optimal theoretical normalizer, not an implementable operational system.

A developer-level JavaScript Proxy intercepting property accesses within the Node.js runtime to verify simulator separation. It provides zero kernel-level isolation, zero process separation, and zero protection against adversarial execution within the same V8 isolate.
